question: Find concrete supplier changes or buyer-specific operational signals.
finding: New primary regulatory source establishes Onyx registration specifically for deucrictibant; no buyer-specific takeover signal found.

observations.fact: MHRA UK API21540 names Onyx Scientific at Wayfarer Road,Sunderland and deucrictibant monohydrate. Scope includes chemical synthesis, intermediates, crude API, recrystallisation, finishing, packaging and QC.
observations.limit: Registration is not order volume, proof of current batches, first registration date, FDA approval or named commercial supply contract.

observations.fact: All three describe two API CDMOs plus IR and XR drug-product CDMOs. FY2024 report describes further clinical packaging/distribution CDMO. FY2025 report adds commercial finished-product packaging/labeling organization.
observations.limit: Number consistency does not identify suppliers or rule out replacement. Disclosure changes do not date contract signing.

normalized_manufacturing_excerpts.2023: Manufacturing and Supply We currently have two CDMOs for the production of deucrictibant API. A robust and scalable synthetic route has been established. All raw materials can be purchased from multiple suppliers. We also collaborate with a leading CDMO for the manufacturing of the on-demand treatment product PHVS416. Another well-established CDMO produces the prophylactic treatment product PHVS719. The two CDMOs that manufacture both PHVS416 and PHVS719 are responsible for packaging and worldwide distribution of other commercial drug products.
normalized_manufacturing_excerpts.2024: Manufacturing and Supply We currently have two CDMOs for the production of deucrictibant API. A robust and scalable synthetic route has been established. All raw materials can be purchased from multiple suppliers. We also partner with a leading CDMO for the manufacturing of the on-demand treatment product, deucrictibant IR capsules. Another well-established CDMO produces the prophylactic treatment product, deucrictibant XR tablets. A further CDMO with a global footprint is responsible for packaging and worldwide distribution of Clinical Trial Material.
normalized_manufacturing_excerpts.2025: Manufacturing and Supply We currently have two CDMOs for the production of deucrictibant active pharmaceutical ingredient (API). A robust and scalable synthetic route has been established. All raw materials can be purchased from multiple suppliers. We also partner with a leading CDMO for the manufacturing of the on-demand treatment product, deucrictibant IR capsules. Another well-established CDMO produces the prophylactic treatment product, deucrictibant XR tablets. A CDMO with a global footprint is responsible for packaging and worldwide distribution of Clinical Trial Material. We partnered with a further Commercial Packaging Organization (CPO) with a global footprint for the packaging and labeling of commercial finished drug product.

hypotheses.buyer_transfer: No named acquirer facility, transfer announcement or termination identified.
hypotheses.launch_scaleup: Added commercial packaging function is consistent with ordinary launch preparation.
hypotheses.supplier_reduction: No evidence of reduced Onyx purchasing; unobservable from these records.

method: Six initial queries plus three follow-ups to concrete MHRA lead; retrieved official registration, compared existing three annual filings. Wayback CDX attempt for Onyx testimonial2023-2026 timed out. No bulk scraping.
decision: No acquisition-probability adjustment. Upgrade confidence in identifying Onyx drug-specific registered scope; retain dated baseline for any future actual counterparty change.
limits: No full international manufacturer census, historical registration series, procurement volumes or private communications. Cannot infer activity level from registration.
